calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date_utc,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('delivered', 'collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
